title: Secure userPracticeLog.ts and userPreferences.ts
description: Apply the same ctx.auth pattern to userPracticeLog.ts and userPreferences.ts. Remove all visitorId arguments.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Import getAuthUserId, requireAuth from authHelpers in both files
userPracticeLog: Remove visitorId from all args
userPracticeLog: Use by_user index for all queries
userPreferences: Remove visitorId from all args
userPreferences: Use by_user index for all queries

notes:
Follow the EXACT same pattern as SEC-003 (wordProgress.ts):

1. Import helpers: `import { getAuthUserId, requireAuth } from './authHelpers'`
2. Remove visitorId from args: `args: {}` or only non-user args
3. Get userId inside handler: `const userId = await requireAuth(ctx)`
4. Query by userId: `.withIndex('by_user', q => q.eq('userId', userId))`
